_help: One entry per export (the packages that cannot update themselves from inside PythonOS).
version: the release version in which this export last CHANGED. Bump it only when the package itself
changed (new APK UI, new launcher or bundled Python, new ISO kernel/boot/lockdown) - NOT for core-only
changes, which the in-OS updater installs. Users on an older export are told to download the new one.
api:     minimum export compatibility the CURRENT core needs. Bump it when a core change needs something the
older export lacks (a new Android bridge function, a new library, a new boot feature). Exports with a
lower api are told they must be reinstalled before the core update can be applied.
assets:  release file names; {v} is the release version the file is downloaded from.

android.title: Android app
android.notes: New terminal screen: type straight into the terminal, always scrolled to the bottom, symbol keys, zoom.

iso.title: Bootable ISO
iso.notes: Locked down: boot menu and consoles can no longer reach the Linux system underneath.
